registered: 2026-10-22, before run04 is built or started
reference: the winner of the run03 decision (run03 best if R1-R5 pass, otherwise run02 best.pt ad3d7910...)
candidate_selection: same as run03: audit -> shortlist of <=3 by trailing pu_min -> production_shortlist_eval against the reference

acceptance.R1_R5: run03's R1-R5 unchanged, with the reference above in place of run02 for R2
acceptance.G1_genstyle_stress: FROZEN stress set = validation_kit SDR degraded by GeneratorStyleAugment(p=1, seed=20261022, default ops), built and hashed BEFORE any run04 checkpoint is scored. PU21 gain vs bt1886 baseline: lower CI > 0, and candidate-minus-reference CI lower bound > 0 (run04 must actually help here, not just tie)
acceptance.G2_clean_cost: clean validation mean gain >= reference minus 0.15 dB (the augmentation must not buy robustness by losing clean quality)
acceptance.G3_generated_review: training/generative_review.py on the owner's generated clips (folder fixed before scoring): no clip gains a FLAG the reference does not have; flicker_excess_ev not worse than reference on any clip by > 0.01
acceptance.G4_visual: owner side-by-side on 10 generated clips, blind A/B order: diagnostic, reported, cannot confirm alone

limits: G1 is synthetic degradation of real validation frames, not real generator output; G3 has no reference HDR, so it can only catch defects (lifted blacks, seams, flicker, clipping), never prove accuracy
